reason: I have never paid for an app and I'm not starting now. If the download isn't too heavy I'd put the free letters and numbers on the phone for my kid, maybe even try the 14 days since no card is needed, but when it asks for 24,990 a month I just stop and keep using the free part and YouTube.
objection: I can get letters and numbers free on YouTube and in the free version, so why pay every month? And I don't know how big the download is. Our internet is slow and I don't have Wi-Fi everywhere.
would_change_my_mind: If the kindergarten teacher or a lot of parents in our Telegram group said it really got their kids ready for first grade, and it was a small one-time payment instead of a monthly subscription.
